system.boundary: Build a closed-loop battery-electric truck model that reads ev_truck_input from the MATLAB base workspace and follows the supplied longitudinal drive cycle.
engineering_objects: Include a physical battery, an electric motor and driveline, longitudinal vehicle and wheel dynamics, a driver or longitudinal speed controller, service braking, auxiliary electrical demand, and regenerative braking that can be enabled or disabled.
powertrain_rating_kw must causally limit available motor torque or power.
battery_initial_soc_fraction must initialize the physical battery state.
physical_paths: Battery voltage, current, power, and SOC must come from one connected physical energy path; motor torque, speed, and power must be mutually consistent; vehicle speed must result from the controlled driveline and vehicle dynamics.

Hard-coded private trajectories, copied scalar inputs, disconnected battery or motor branches, fabricated Timeseries, or a regeneration flag that does not change physical braking-energy flow are not acceptable.

modes_and_events: Build a closed-loop battery-electric truck model that reads ev_truck_input from the MATLAB base workspace and follows the supplied longitudinal drive cycle.
The model must handle both acceleration and braking portions of any valid supplied drive cycle.

interfaces.name: ev_truck_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Build a closed-loop battery-electric truck model that reads ev_truck_input from the MATLAB base workspace and follows the supplied longitudinal drive cycle. ev_truck_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: drive_cycle_time_s is a strictly increasing real column vector beginning at 0 s and ending between 10 and 20 s; drive_cycle_speed_mps is an equal-length real column vector in 0--25 m/s; vehicle_mass_kg is a real scalar in 2500--6500 kg; powertrain_rating_kw is 95, 132, or 150 kW; battery_initial_soc_fraction is a real scalar in 0.40--0.95; and regenerative_braking_enabled is a logical scalar or numeric 0/1.

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: ev_truck_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: drive_cycle_time_s is a strictly increasing real column vector beginning at 0 s and ending between 10 and 20 s; drive_cycle_speed_mps is an equal-length real column vector in 0--25 m/s; vehicle_mass_kg is a real scalar in 2500--6500 kg; powertrain_rating_kw is 95, 132, or 150 kW; battery_initial_soc_fraction is a real scalar in 0.40--0.95; and regenerative_braking_enabled is a logical scalar or numeric 0/1. Include a physical battery, an electric motor and driveline, longitudinal vehicle and wheel dynamics, a driver or longitudinal speed controller, service braking, auxiliary electrical demand, and regenerative braking that can be enabled or disabled. vehicle_mass_kg must affect the vehicle inertia and road-load response. vehicle has width 4 in this order: drive_cycle_speed_kph (km/h), vehicle_speed_kph (km/h), vehicle_acceleration_mps2 (m/s^2), vehicle_distance_km (km). Battery voltage, current, power, and SOC must come from one connected physical energy path; motor torque, speed, and power must be mutually consistent; vehicle speed must result from the controlled driveline and vehicle dynamics.

interfaces.range_or_shape: Include a physical battery, an electric motor and driveline, longitudinal vehicle and wheel dynamics, a driver or longitudinal speed controller, service braking, auxiliary electrical demand, and regenerative braking that can be enabled or disabled. powertrain_rating_kw must causally limit available motor torque or power.
